items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: one of the first guys that I had a personal management on was Bill Davis.

ctx.x: Kid Carter. And I can't think of the... I can think of names in the band, but I can only call first names. The guitar player was from Des Moines, and he was called Bill. Now, I don't remember the bass player...
What did you guys do? Did you just play a regular gig, or was it like a one night stand?
